reasoning_checks: Original Nacre continuing-business case is distinct from c12 finite equipment/service alternatives: normalized terminal capital and peer evidence meet a first-year maturity wall and explicit final refinancing.

All financial cash is excluded from operating capital and FCFF, including the required reserve; it has a stipulated fair4% after-tax return and par value. The bridge and owner cash-account treatment explicitly depend on that convention.
Operating EBIT tax is25% and interest is nondeductible by fictional assumption. No WACC tax adjustment, APV shield or second tax charge on cash interest is introduced.

Required operating return10% follows illustrative4%+1.2×5%, with no claim of empirical estimation. Conditional expected forecasts and supplied debt quotes are separate; the two cases are not a complete set of priced states and supply no probability-weighted optimum.

Terminal turnover16/13, EBITDAmargin18%, depreciation5% and tax25% imply ROIC12% on all opening operating capital. Growth2% requires net reinvestment gK; year4 capex and NWC changes exactly reproduce closing capital1.02K.

TV3 starts with FCFF4; explicit FCFF3 is included once. Date0 total operating DCF is distinguished from terminal value. Peak explicit NOPAT and a one-time capital release are not extrapolated as stable economics.

Subscription70 increases both company financial assets and buyer outlay by70; a payout reduces company value and returns the same owner cash. Sale30 reclassifies the excluded asset. Price500 goes to old owners and fee8 to an outside adviser, not company treasury.

Peer prices, debt/NCI and forward EBITDA all share dates and perimeter. Documented expense normalization is balanced by bonus/gain removal; negative EBITDA and software operating differences remain visible in the full universe.

Term and revolver interest use opening principal; cash yield uses opening cash. At dates1/2 the actual revolver limit combines total commitment and remaining-term leverage headroom. Failed paths stop with a shortfall and no asserted feasible close.

At date3 all old term and revolving debt is paid before replacement proceeds. The explicit undated note remains outstanding, its annual coupon is included from date4 and no uncommitted renewal or hidden principal maturity is assumed.

The minimum-equity and maximum-initial-payout policies have the same company opening cash and full future treasury paths. Collection delay releases at date2, so its later interest effect differs from a permanent cost. Every boundary is feasible through date3; small steps beyond fail at date1.

The stated two-forecast nonnegative-NPV screening rule caps seller price439.946281, whereas other explicit risk criteria can support different conditional judgments. Funding feasibility is separate from value and from real daily liquidity.

Collection and terminal-margin interventions are first reported separately. Combined conditional operating value includes the delayed-collection PV loss; the original corporate plan remains unfunded without new explicit authority.

All six rubric domains total100 and apply75% floors with fractional credit,85% total and transfer/teach-back. Critical errors require remediation, and consistent arithmetic errors receive carry-forward treatment.

Canonical run policy and named fixed experiments are validated instead of silently accepting contradictory edited fields; explicit treasury arguments support the documented alternatives within the bounded model.

limitations: Synthetic teaching contracts, market quotes and tax premises are supplied assumptions; no legal compliance, actual financing availability, investment advice or observed company evidence is certified.
Conditional operating DCF and independent debt quotes do not form a complete default-pricing system; absent probabilities preclude a unique expected transaction NPV.

Fair-return financial cash, synchronized annual payments, abrupt terminal normalization and an undated note are explicit simplifications. The package cannot establish intrayear liquidity or real operational execution.
The lab deliberately fixes named benchmark policies, three explicit periods and positive-EBIT tax treatment; it is not a universal reporting, capital-structure, loss-tax or portfolio engine.
Authored time/scoring guidance is not empirically calibrated. Agent review is not independent human certification, learner performance evidence or a guarantee of error-free work.
